Text: Luna sits with a book beneath the warm light of a Wonderland garden. She looks up as you approach, then offers a shy smile while a distant shadow reminds you both of the Demon Lord's threat.

Alice stands with her arms crossed before a white wooden gate. Her sharp eyes size you up, but the slight curve of her smile says she is curious whether you are brave enough to face the Demon Lord with her.
Ryne waves from a flower-lined forest path, bright-eyed and ready for trouble. She looks eager to turn the journey toward the Demon Lord into an adventure you can survive together.
Raven stands quietly beside a stained-glass window. She does not speak first, but her steady gaze suggests she is waiting to see whether you understand the darkness gathering around the Demon Lord.
